tools.description: Automatically repair and sanitize an entire draft CSV block (QA or Cloze). Enforces canonical header, repairs unescaped pipes and newlines in long free-text fields, escapes clinical inequalities (< 10, > 50) and bare '&', converts basic markdown, and auto-closes simple unclosed tags. Returns fixed_csv, fixes_applied, and residual diagnostics.
tools.name: batch_auto_fix

collision.reason: Same name, different contract: the Python legacy tool patches a persistent staging file (`staging_path`, 0-based `card_index`, `patch_json` string), while the Rust server is a pure in-memory patcher taking `draft` and `updates` objects and performing no disk I/O. On the Rust server use `mcp_batch_patch_draft_args`.

tools.description: Apply a surgical patch directly to a CardDraft within a persistent batch staging file. staging_path: path to drafts.jsonl or .staging_{batch_id}/drafts.jsonl. card_index: 0-based index of card to update. patch_json: JSON string with 'updates'.
tools.name: batch_patch_draft

tools.description: Apply a surgical patch or field updates to a single CardDraft JSON object. Allows repairing a failed card in isolation without regenerating the entire batch. card_json: JSON string of CardDraft. patch_json: JSON string with 'updates' dictionary.
tools.name: card_patch_apply

tools.description: Partition invalid cards out of the active batch into a quarantine record. Allows the remaining valid cards to advance through G3 export under PARTIAL_PASS. drafts_json: list of CardDraft objects. failed_indices: 0-based indices of cards to isolate.
tools.name: card_quarantine

collision.reason: Same name, different contract: the Python legacy tool takes `drafts_json` (a JSON string of a list or {"cards": [...]}) plus `auto_renumber`/`auto_purge_ids`, while the Rust server takes a typed `drafts` array plus `auto_renumber_cloze`/`auto_purge_id_leaks`/`default_campo_estudo`/`compile_mode`. On the Rust server use `mcp_compile_drafts_args`.

tools.description: Compile a list of structured CardDraft JSON objects into AnkiMBR-compliant QA and Cloze CSV blocks. Applies deterministic HTML escaping, sequential cloze renumbering (c1..cN), ID leak purging, markdown table conversion, and pipe-delimiter escaping. Accepts a JSON string of a list or {'cards': [...]}. Returns qa_csv, cloze_csv, and compilation stats.
tools.name: cards_compile_drafts

tools.description: Load and index an extractor catalog (catalog.json, anki_catalog.csv, catalog.md, or central_images.json) into active memory and optionally register it in the deck's manifesto.json. Returns counts of figures, tables, valid clinical items, filtered extraction noise, and version hash.
tools.name: catalog_load

tools.description: Compare corpus vocabulary against the deck Manifesto to identify coverage gaps.
tools.name: corpus_coverage

deck_dir.description: Absolute path to the deck directory (must contain manifesto.json).

tools.description: Unified triage + coverage report for all corpus files in the deck.
tools.name: corpus_digest

deck_dir.description: Absolute path to the deck directory (must contain manifesto.json).

tools.description: Persist source material into the deck's corpus directory for later triage.
tools.name: corpus_load

deck_dir.description: Absolute path to the deck directory (must contain manifesto.json).

label.description:
Descriptive name for this source (e.g. 'harrison_cap4', 'notebooklm_ep').
Converted automatically to a safe filename.

text.description: Source material to save (markdown, plain text, or pasted excerpt).

tools.description: Score source material for flashcard potential. Pass inline text or a stored label.
tools.name: corpus_triage

deck_dir.description: Absolute path to the deck directory.

label.description: Label of a previously stored corpus file (via ``corpus_load``).

text.description: Inline source material to score. Takes priority over *label*.

tools.description: Count the Anki card budget for a batch. QA notes = 1 card each. Cloze notes: each distinct cN index = 1 card. Returns qa_cards, cloze_notes, cloze_indices (expanded count), total, within_limit (≤20), excess, and ext_batch_suggested if over the limit.
tools.name: count_batch_cards

tools.description:
Build a single, guaranteed-safe pipe-delimited CSV row from a list of field values. Applies all formatting-guide rules: newlines→
, pipe→|, inequalities→</>, bare &→& without double-escaping, while preserving valid HTML tags. fields must match the note type: 7 values for QA, 6 for Cloze. Returns the safe CSV line string.
tools.name: csv_build_row

tools.description: Full deck health audit: orphan IDs, phantom IDs, batch integrity, and coverage summary.
tools.name: deck_audit

tools.description: Add a new subdeck to the 02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR hierarchy and persist the update immediately. subdeck_path: the full or relative subdeck path to add (e.g. '02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR::Ciclo Clínico::Oftalmologia::Catarata'). Automatically creates all missing parent levels in the hierarchy.
tools.name: deck_hierarchy_add

tools.description: Get the registered deck hierarchy for 02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR. filter_prefix: optional sub-path filter (e.g. '02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR::Ciclo Clínico::Neurologia'). max_depth: max nesting level to include (default 10). format_tree: if true, returns an ASCII/Unicode visual tree instead of list.
tools.name: deck_hierarchy_get

tools.description: Search the 02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR hierarchy for subdecks matching a keyword or topic. query: search string (e.g. 'Catarata', 'Neurologia', 'Glaucoma', 'Esclerose'). root_deck: root prefix to restrict to (default '02_MEDICINA_AnkiMBR').
tools.name: deck_hierarchy_search

tools.description: Synchronize deck hierarchy from the live Anki SQLite database collection.anki2. Safely handles running Anki locks and merges with any manually added subdecks.
tools.name: deck_hierarchy_sync

tools.description: Final transactional export of a validated batch; the SOLE writer of the final CSV files and of the Manifesto post-export. Requires the content_hash returned by pipeline_gate_check / validate_batch on PASS. Order: receipt check and full re-validation (read-only) → under one deck lock: ID checks, staged writes, replace, manifesto save; any failure rolls files back. Re-running with the same receipt on an exported batch returns ALREADY_EXPORTED and writes nothing. Parameters: deck_dir; batch_id; qa_csv; cloze_csv; receipt_hash; new_ids_json (JSON array of {id, batch, type, status, topic, anchor}); new_topics_json (JSON array of strings); changelog_json (JSON array of changelog objects); topic_slug (optional, e.g. 'EscleroseMultipla'); write_to_deck_root (also copy into the deck root, default True). Writes: deck_dir/exports/{batch_id}[_{topic_slug}]_QA.csv and _Cloze.csv.
tools.name: export_final

tools.description: Log a gap or unresolved decision point that halts the pipeline. Per the Gap Request Protocol in anki-card-generator: when the pipeline encounters a decision without a governing rule, it MUST halt and log here instead of inventing ad-hoc rules. deck_dir: deck folder path. batch_id: e.g. 'B07'. gap_description: clear description of the decision needed. context: relevant snippet or options. Returns a gap_id and logs it to the Manifesto suggestion queue.
tools.name: gap_request

tools.description: Query the ID ledger. filters: comma-separated values like 'batch=B01', 'status=active', 'type=QA'. Returns matching ID entries and a summary.
tools.name: id_ledger_query

tools.description: Rank and retrieve relevant figure and table entries from an extractor catalog. Uses token-based, accent-insensitive clinical matching across title, caption, tags, and filename, automatically filtering out extraction noise (dummy captions, copyright headers, tiny logos). item_type: 'all' | 'figure' | 'table'. Returns ranked candidates with ready-to-use namespaced filename, table dimensions, and <figure> HTML.
tools.name: image_candidates

tools.description: Apply the slug prefix to convert a raw filename to its Anki-safe namespaced form. Avoids double-prefixing when extractor filenames already contain the document prefix.
tools.name: image_namespace

tools.description: Summary report across one or more catalogs: totals, figures, tables, noise, sync ratios.
tools.name: image_report

tools.description: Check consistency between a catalog and Anki collection.media. If apply=True, executes transactional copying of missing files (under their namespaced name) to collection.media, skipping noise entries unless copy_noise=True.
tools.name: image_sync

tools.description: Sole writer of the Manifesto. Commits a batch's data transactionally. Requires a valid receipt (content_hash from validate_batch PASS). Parameters: deck_dir, batch_id, receipt_hash, qa_csv, cloze_csv (for receipt verification), new_ids (JSON array of IDEntry dicts), new_topics (JSON array of strings), new_tags (comma-separated), changelog_entries (JSON array), queue_updates (JSON array of strings to add).
tools.name: manifesto_commit

tools.description: Import a legacy manifesto.md into manifesto.json format. Parses the markdown file and creates manifesto.json. deck_dir: folder containing the manifesto.md. manifesto_md_name: filename (default 'manifesto.md'). Reports all parsed sections and any parsing issues.
tools.name: manifesto_import

tools.description: Initialize a new manifesto.json for a deck. deck_dir: absolute path to the deck folder. campo_estudo: e.g. 'Medicina::Neurologia::ELA'. deck_slug: short identifier (e.g. 'ela'). taxonomy_root: root tag (e.g. 'ELA'). Will NOT overwrite an existing manifesto.json.
tools.name: manifesto_init

tools.description: Register the top-down total card budget plan for a topic into the Manifesto before drafting. Enforces that the TOTAL quantity of cards is planned before complete production, chunked strictly into batches of 20 (MAX_BATCH = 20).
tools.name: manifesto_plan_set

tools.description: Read the current state of the Manifesto. deck_dir: absolute path to the deck folder. sections: comma-separated subset to return ('all', 'ids', 'topics', 'taxonomy', 'catalogs', 'changelog', 'queue', 'batches').
tools.name: manifesto_state

tools.description: Construct a standardized AnkiMBR <figure> tag with clinical caption. Ensures semantic container formatting (class='anki-figure') without inline styles. Supports optional title and context_link to connect the image/table to the card's clinical concept.
tools.name: media_figure_build

tools.description: Evaluate all gate checks for a pipeline phase without advancing the state. A PASS records the receipt for the batch (content_hash); a FAIL or INCOMPLETE invalidates any earlier receipt for that phase. Also returns read-only information_profiles (3-layer breakdown per row, excluded from receipt hash; length-only signals are advisory WARN, never blocking). deck_dir: deck folder (manifesto + anki_catalog.csv). batch_id: e.g. 'B07'. phase: drafted|curated|enriched|illustrated|validated. qa_csv / cloze_csv: full CSV texts. detail: 'compact' (default; diagnostics aggregated by code with affected rows) or 'full' (every check). Verdict: PASS | INCOMPLETE (a check could not run; no receipt) | FAIL.
tools.name: pipeline_gate_check

tools.description: Advance a batch through the pipeline state machine. deck_dir: absolute path to the deck folder. batch_id: e.g. 'B07'. Leaving a phase requires the receipt recorded by a PASS of pipeline_gate_check(phase=<current state>). receipt_hash is optional; if given it must equal that recorded receipt. Allowed transitions: started→drafted→curated→enriched→illustrated→validated→exported.
tools.name: pipeline_phase_advance

tools.description: One-shot batch review: runs every check over QA + Cloze CSVs and returns an aggregated report with fix hints, read-only information_profiles (separating retrieved target, necessary context, and optional explanation; semantic_review_required=True; no automatic QA->Cloze conversion; excluded from receipt hash), and the receipt (content_hash on PASS). If deck_dir is given and batch_id is registered, the gate is recorded like pipeline_gate_check. detail: 'compact' (default) or 'full'.
tools.name: review_batch

tools.description:
Sanitize a single card field: converts mathematical/clinical inequalities (< 10, > 50, <=, >=) to HTML entities (<, >, ≤, ≥), bare & to &, pipes to |, newlines to
, while strictly preserving valid HTML tags (, , , ,
    ,
  • ,
tools.name: sanitize_card_field

tools.description: Validate a TableSpec JSON string, render it to single-line HTML without inline styles, and run table checks. Returns {status: 'PASS'|'FAIL', html: str, diagnostics: list}.
tools.name: table_build

tools.description:
Convert GitHub-style markdown tables in text (with raw or escaped pipes, separated by newlines or
) into HTML tables. Returns {status: 'PASS'|'FAIL', text: str, tables_converted: int, diagnostics: list}.
tools.name: table_from_markdown

tools.description: Check tags against the Manifesto taxonomy. tags: space-separated list. Returns ok/unregistered/depth/format per tag.
tools.name: taxonomy_check

tools.description: Calculate top-down total card budget for a topic based on source text and clinical decisions. Plans total cards upfront and chunks strictly into batches of 20 (MAX_BATCH = 20).
tools.name: topic_budget_plan

tools.description: Calibrate topic flashcard budget via Sectional HCT with JEV System 1 & Must-Cover Matrix. Slices source into clinical sections, computes expected cards (EV), and partitions into batches <= 20.
tools.name: topic_triage_calibrate

tools.description: Full batch validation: runs every export-validator check over a complete QA CSV + Cloze CSV pair. Returns a ValidationReport with a verdict: PASS (content_hash = receipt), INCOMPLETE (some check could not run; see skipped; no receipt) or FAIL, plus read-only information_profiles (3-layer profile per row with note_type and row; excluded from receipt hash; length-only signals are advisory WARN). taxonomy_tags: space-separated registered tags. active_ids / current_batch_ids: comma-separated. catalog_filenames: comma-separated namespaced image filenames (needed to verify sources; without it, image-bearing rows are reported as skipped).
tools.name: validate_batch

tools.description: Validate cloze syntax in a 'Sentença' field value. Checks: sequential c1..cN indices (operational cap 3; each index creates a separate Anki card with other indices visible), no nested deletions, boundary/length advisory WARN signals (length alone never proves atomicity and a single gap can hide a list). Returns: status, detected indices, card_count (= distinct cN), diagnostics, and information_profile (per-index 3-layer breakdown, candidate_items, 6-question checklist; read-only, no quality score).
tools.name: validate_cloze

tools.description: Check cross-references in any field text. active_ids and current_batch_ids are comma-separated ID strings. XREF.BROKEN is emitted for IDs that do not resolve.
tools.name: validate_crossrefs

tools.description: Validate the structural integrity of a QA or Cloze CSV block. Checks: header match, column count, raw pipes, raw newlines, HTML entities, forbidden tags, MathJax balance, and UTF-8 BOM. note_type must be 'QA' (7 fields) or 'CL' (6 fields).
tools.name: validate_csv_structure

tools.description: Validate hints in a cloze sentence '{{cN::target::hint}}'. Checks: HINT.SYNONYM (high overlap), HINT.ELIMINATION (binary alternatives), HINT.ROOT_LEAK (target root in hint), HINT.FORMAT (empty hint).
tools.name: validate_hints

tools.description: Validate the 'Imagens Relacionadas' HTML field. Checks: IMG.CAP_OVER (>3), IMG.PHANTOM (src not in catalog), IMG.NAMESPACE (invalid slug prefix), IMG.DUP_IN_CARD, IMG.STRUCTURE (
tools.name: validate_images_field

tools.description: Validate the 'Notas Adicionais' optional explanation field (same unit, authorized source; empty/short notes allowed with no minimum volume and variable depth). Checks: NOTE.METADATA (CRITICAL), NOTE.DUP_ANSWER_WARN (normalized HTML/entity/punctuation exact repeat), NOTE.EXAM_ONLY_WARN (exam mention without explanation), NOTE.LENGTH_WARN, NOTE.STYLE_WARN. Returns information_profile (note_type='QA', prompt_available=False limitation noted).
tools.name: validate_notes

tools.description: Validate a QA pair (stem + answer), separating retrieved recall target from necessary stem context (stem context length is not extra recall; length-only checks emit WARN, never CRITICAL). Checks: QA.CARDINALITY (≥3 items → review unit, split independent recalls or move optional details to notes; no automatic QA->Cloze conversion), QA.YESNO, QA.MC_EMBED, QA.CONTEXT_WARN, QA.NUMBER_UNIT. Returns information_profile with candidate_items, evidence, and 6-question editorial checklist.
tools.name: validate_qa

tools.description: Validate HTML table syntax, mobile screen constraints, and check for markdown table leaks. Returns {status: 'PASS'|'FAIL', diagnostics: list}.
tools.name: validate_tables_field

tools.description: Validate the 'Etiquetas' field. Checks: TAG.FORMAT (spaces/invalid chars), TAG.DEPTH (>4 levels), TAG.UNREGISTERED (against provided taxonomy). taxonomy_tags: space-separated string of all registered tags (or empty to skip taxonomy check).
tools.name: validate_tags_field
